# Security policy

rox parses untrusted files (audio, tags, cover art, playlists, lyrics) and
talks to a handful of web services. If you've found a way to make that
dangerous, say memory corruption from a crafted file, path traversal through an
m3u, or credentials leaking somewhere, I want to know.

## Reporting

Report privately through
[GitHub's vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/zealsprince/rox/security/advisories/new)
or email andrew@zealsprince.com. If you'd rather reach me somewhere else,
[zealsprince.com](https://zealsprince.com) links out to everywhere I'm active.
Don't open a public issue for anything exploitable. You'll hear back within a
week, and you'll be credited in the fix unless you'd rather not be.

## Scope

The latest release and main. Crashes without a security angle are regular bugs;
the [bug report form](https://github.com/zealsprince/rox/issues/new/choose) is
the right door for those.
